item.title: As Atlanta universities scramble to adhere to Trump directives ending DEI programs, many students and staff feel abandoned
item.description: Emory University, along with several other Atlanta universities, announced they would comply with President Donald Trump’s directives to higher-education institutions to end programs dedicated to DEI. According to students and faculty from two metro-area universities, the overall impact has been a systematic chipping away at the resources and programs that support students from minority groups on campus—which, for many of them, were a major draw to the university in the first place. item.title: A former bank turned boutique hotel is bringing retro glamour to Savannah
item.description: The new boutique property sits on Savannah’s East Broughton Street and beckons guests and passersby into its light-filled, high-ceilinged lobby bar. Loungey velvet seating in shades of dusty pink and pistachio green, original terrazzo floors, blue mosaic wall tiling, and retro light fixtures give the gathering space a midcentury modern feel. item.description: Author Tayari Jones has a knack for weaving new threads through the familiar theme of family. item.description: On an Augusta street lined with multimillion-dollar homes, 1015 Monte Sano Avenue stands as a reminder that charm can outshine sheer size.
